name: Town Portal Rework
description:
Town Portal spell is nerfed - you need to know more than one magic school to use it at advanced or expert level. The exact spell mechanics are:

- With expert Earth Magic and Basic Fire or Water Magic Town Portal is cast at advanced level.
- With expert Earth Magic and expert Fire or Water Magic Town Portal is cast at expert level.
- With expert Fire Magic and expert Water magic Town Portal is cast at advanced level.

As a side effect of this implementation, players need to cast Town Portal Invocation spell for 0 mana in order to get Town Portal in their spellbook. The invocation spell needs to be cast for each hero only once per game.
author: wnukos
